question: What claim is made about the uniqueness of the knowledge given by this teaching with respect to any future equal knowledge?
premises: Knowledge equal to this knowledge exists by means of this teaching.
No equal knowledge will exist again.
No equal knowledge will exist at all in that sense.
inference: There is no knowledge equal to this, and there will be none again.
uncertainties: The scope of 'again' is not determined by this verse alone.
plain_english: There is no knowledge equal to this, nor will there be again.
